nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $n$ a natural number. For all $n \times n$ matrices $M_1, \dots, M_{2n}$ over $R$, the sum over all permutations $\sigma$ of $\{1, \dots, 2n\}$ of $\mathrm{sgn}(\sigma) M_{\sigma(1)} M_{\sigma(2)} \cdots M_{\sigma(2n)}$ is the zero matrix, where $\mathrm{sgn}(\sigma) \in \{1, -1\}$ is the sign of $\sigma$. In other words, the standard polynomial of degree $2n$ vanishes on…
nodes.title: Amitsur–Levitzki theorem

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $n$ a natural number, and $A$ a $k$-subalgebra of the algebra $M_n(k)$ of $n \times n$ matrices over $k$. Suppose that the only subspaces $W$ of $k^n$ with $Mv \in W$ for all $M \in A$ and all $v \in W$ are $0$ and $k^n$. Then $A = M_n(k)$.
nodes.title: Burnside's theorem on matrix algebras

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a finite-dimensional associative unital division algebra over $\mathbb{R}$. Then $A$ is isomorphic as an $\mathbb{R}$-algebra to $\mathbb{R}$, to $\mathbb{C}$, or to the algebra $\mathbb{H}$ of real quaternions.
nodes.title: Frobenius theorem on real division algebras

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a field and let $A$ be a finite-dimensional central simple algebra over $k$. Then every $k$-algebra automorphism $\sigma$ of $A$ is inner: there is a unit $u \in A^\times$ such that $\sigma(x) = u x u^{-1}$ for all $x \in A$.
nodes.title: Skolem–Noether theorem

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
